facts.text: The upstream class is device and opens the VISA resource passed to __init__ (default GPIB0::14)
X, Y, R and Theta are read with OUTP? 1 through OUTP? 4 and each reply is converted to float
get_all asks SNAP?1,2,3,4 for the four data values in one exchange
The demo block parses the get_all reply as comma-separated X, Y, R and Theta in that order
The time constant is addressed by index: 0 is 10 us, 6 is 10 ms, 10 is 1 s and 19 is 30 ks
The sensitivity is addressed by index: 0 is 2 nV, 17 is 1 mV, 23 is 100 mV and 26 is 1 V
A setting is sent as the command word followed by one argument (FREQ %f, SLVL %f, PHAS %f)
A query with an argument is sent as the command word, a question mark and the argument (DDEF? %i)
The front panel is overridden with OVRM 1 (disabled) and OVRM 0 (enabled)
The auxiliary output is written as AUXV output, value with three decimal places
The auxiliary output is read back as AUXV? output
